dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: DLBCL, NOS, non-germinal-center (activated B-cell) type by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in about 80 percent of cells).

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: DLBCL, NOS, non-germinal-center (activated B-cell) type by the Hans algorithm

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a second malignancy, NOT recurrent or metastatic breast cancer: ... cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in lesional cells

stage_iii.quote: Lugano (2014) stage IIIBS, with the S suffix for splenic involvement.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Lugano designates splenic involvement with the S suffix rather than as an extranodal organ, so this is IIIBS rather than IVS

stage_b_symptoms.quote: evening fevers to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats 2 to 3 times weekly and 3 percent weight loss give B symptoms (B).

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass is 7.5 cm (below the 10 cm bulky threshold, above the 7 cm threshold used in several DLBCL trials)

mn_stage_iv.quote: this is IIIBS rather than IVS; either coding carries identical management and prognosis here, and I would re-stage to IV only if GI wall, liver, lung or marrow involvement emerges.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Under the WHO-HAEM5 convention (MYC at least 50 percent AND BCL2 at least 50 percent) she is NOT a double expressor; under the older MYC-at-least-40-percent convention she would be labelled a double expressor.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Interphase FISH on 200 nuclei: no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma and not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is not the answer to the cardiac problem because EPOCH contains doxorubicin.

prog_ipi_2.quote: International prognostic index (IPI) 2 (age 59 gives 0, stage III gives 1, ECOG 1 gives 0, LDH 510 (2.3x ULN) gives 1, one extranodal site (spleen) gives 0), which is low-intermediate risk

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Reasons for prophylaxis rather than observation: CNS-IPI 2 sits in the intermediate band (NCCN: consider CNS prophylaxis at 2 to 3 points)

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal methotrexate 12.5 mg (with intrathecal cytarabine if I judge the bulk of disease to warrant it) with cycles 2, 3, 4 and 6

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: do NOT give R-CHOP. Her 2026-09-09 echocardiogram shows LVEF 45 percent with global hypokinesis and global longitudinal strain -14 percent, down from LVEF 62 percent in 2016

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: would make R-CHOP x 6 (or R-CHOP-14) my preferred regimen, because that is the most effective standard therapy and I would only expose her to an anthracycline if her heart had demonstrably recovered

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: cardiology/cardio-oncology review with baseline ECG, BNP and repeat echocardiogram in about 3 months after blood-pressure optimization

tx_cardioprotection.quote: adding an ACE inhibitor or ARB plus a beta-blocker in consultation with cardiology for LVEF 45 percent and GLS -14 percent

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: start curative-intent combination immunochemotherapy WITHOUT an anthracycline - R-CVP for 6 cycles on a 21-day cycle with primary G-CSF support

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: it is less effective per cycle than R-CHOP and I accept that loss to protect her cardiac function and overall survival.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeat echocardiography at 3 months, mid-treatment and end of therapy

mn_non_curative.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 6 to 8 weeks after the last dose of chemotherapy and at least 4 to 6 weeks after the last rituximab dose: Deauville 1 to 3 equals complete response and completes therapy with observation

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: she is at meaningful risk given the 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate, LDH 510 and splenic involvement, so allopurinol 300 mg daily from 3 days before cycle 1 through at least cycle 1

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg subcutaneously on day 8 of every cycle as primary neutropenia prophylaxis

sup_anastrozole.quote: continue anastrozole 1 mg daily through November 2026 to complete the planned 10 years - there is no interaction with R-CVP

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HIV-1/2, HBsAg, total anti-HBc, anti-HBs and HCV all non-reactive (so no antiviral or HCV treatment needed, and no need for hepatitis B DNA monitoring)

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy: ECOG 1, 59 years old, working full-time as a school librarian, independent in all activities

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: No cardiology/cardio-oncology consultation is documented despite LVEF 45 percent, GLS -14 percent, prior doxorubicin 240 mg/m2, left breast radiotherapy and a family history of heart failure; no baseline ECG or BNP is recorded.
